item.title: Russian warship sinks in Benghazi after suspected Ukrainian drone attack

item.title: U.S. Army plans to invoke emergency provisions to detonate bomb-making chemicals in Iowa
item.description:
The U.S. Army set off waves of anxiety in Iowa when it confirmed plans to carry out two controlled explosions at an ammunition facility there with just a few days’ notice . According to the Army, dozens of old barrels containing lead azide , an explosive used as a detonator, have become unstable and pose an “ unacceptable risk of accidental detonation .” Intentionally detonating the barrels is considered the best option for controlling the risk, the Army determined. However, the explosions are expected to release a large plume of lead particles, and lead is a neurotoxin. The Iowa Army Ammunition Plant is in Middletown, a town of about 360 residents in southeast Iowa. People and farms would be in the path of the plume as the wind blows it for miles. item.title: Global Climate Talks Fail Over Fossil Fuel Dispute
item.description:
On the day the largest global climate summit started earlier this month, my colleague Rachel Santarsiero posed a key question : “Will anyone finally say ‘fossil fuels’?” The past three decades of discussions have largely sidestepped the issue despite the fact that fossil fuels are the largest contributor to climate change—and the past two weeks in Turkey have proved no different. item.title: What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?
item.description:
COP31 President Murat Kurum speaks during a plenary session at the COP31 UN Climate Summit on Nov. 11, 2026, in Antalya, Turkey. —Khalil Hamra—AP COP31 , the United Nations’ annual climate change summit, ended on Sunday without consensus on an overarching climate deal after about two days of overtime in Antalya, Türkiye. The annual conference brings together delegates to shape and formalize an approach to combating the effects of global warming . This year, the main dispute was whether the agreement should explicitly call for a transition away from fossil fuels . That commitment traces back to the Paris Agreement , a 2015 climate treaty that calls for efforts to limit global warming to 1.5°C (2.7°F) above preindustrial levels. item.title: How El Chapo Isidro, alleged Mexican cartel leader, was captured
item.description:
Mexican authorities arrested one of the FBI’s Ten Most Wanted fugitives, Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as “Chapo Isidro,” dealing a blow to one of the world’s most powerful cartel networks. Meza Flores, leader of the Beltrán Leyva faction of the “heavily armed” Sinaloa Cartel, was arrested alongside his top lieutenant, Germán Rolando Gálvez Meza. Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) said the arrests resulted from an investigation conducted in coordination with Mexican authorities. item.title: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database
item.description:
Hackers breached the FBI's National Crime Information Center (NCIC), three sources familiar with the matter told Fox News, marking the second cyberattack against the bureau in months. The FBI is investigating the hack to determine the unauthorized entry point, but, for now, it is unclear what information was compromised, sources said. The NCIC database is a critical information-sharing tool for federal, state and local authorities, helping them track fugitives, monitor registered sex offenders, check whether someone has failed a gun background check, among other information. In an interview with Fox News' Kayleigh McEnany Saturday morning, President Donald Trump said he had "just heard" about the hack. item.title: How did Republicans lose so badly in North Carolina?
item.description:
Republicans suffered sweeping losses across the US in the midterm elections, but perhaps nowhere as large as here Republicans suffered sweeping losses across the country in the midterm elections, but perhaps nowhere as large as North Carolina . Democrats flipped a US Senate seat for the first time since 2008, as well as five House seats, one of which Cook Political Report had rated “solid” Republican, and four others considered “likely” Republican.
